flaws.description: address_raw is dropped in the same migration that adds the structured columns, before any backfill, so the source data for parsing is destroyed
Renaming price_text in one step while old lambdas still read it during the rolling deploy causes errors; needs an expand/contract sequence
The neighbourhood page query filters on neighborhood_id and status and sorts by published_at, but only a single-column index exists; a composite index is needed
There is no down migration and the only recovery is a nightly backup taken seven hours earlier, so a bad run loses a business day of broker edits
ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE runs inside the migration transaction and the new archived value is used in the same transaction, which Postgres rejects
The ALTER COLUMN TYPE and generated stored column rewrite the 2.1M-row table under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock during business hours, blocking the site
